description: For HK pass HK:00700 or market=HK. Without codes the HK ranking includes only HKD counters; pass HK:80700 to query the RMB counter directly. Choose session=open/close and view=summary/timeline. HK observed deltas are sampled, final volume and amount are reconciled in trading currency. A-share opening call auction (集合竞价) as its own dataset — today or any past trading day. Items: `canonical_code`, `name`, `auction_price` (= the official open), `prev_close`, `pct_change` (points), `volume` (shares), `amount` (CNY). `stage`: `final` = settled result (after the 09:25 match; backfilled for history) / `live` = today 09:15–09:25 from the live snapshot — before 09:25 that is the INDICATIVE price, `volume`/`amount` null (nothing traded yet). Auction leaderboard: `sort=pct_change` + `limit` (`order=asc` for the weakest); watchlist: `codes`. Empty with a `note` on non-trading days or before the dataset starts. 竞价未匹配量 unmatched 为股，正买负卖；unmatched_as_of 是最后有效竞价观测的源时间（09:25 后冻结），历史未采集为 null。

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

codes.description: Comma-separated canonical codes (max 500); omit for the whole market

view.description: Summary by default; timeline requires one code and a date

name: auction
